Updated `src/solution.py` to remove the Friday cutoff and unsupported lunch, buffer, duration-multiple, and 15-minute-grid restrictions.

The function now treats `day` as informational and returns every feasible minute-resolution start within 09:00–17:00, sorted chronologically. Unsorted and overlapping events remain supported.

All targeted checks and 250 randomized comparisons passed.
